title: Finance x Support sync: credit ledger cut-over
summary: Monthly Finance x Support sync. Main item: the credit ledger cut-over on 1 April 2027. Decisions (Rishi Malhotra, FP&A): (1) from 1 April 2027 Support quotes credit balances and expiry dates only from `credit_ledger`; (2) `credit_grants` is frozen as of 31 March 2027 and is not updated after that, so its remaining amounts go stale and newer grants are missing from it; Support must not quote from it. Cole confirmed the ledger reconciles to the penny against March invoices.
action_items: Dev Patel - tell the support queue about the ledger rule before 1 April
Emily Stone - publish the ledger reading guide (entries, expiry) on the Finance space
Cole Summers - make credit_grants read-only on 31 March
next_steps: Ledger is the only balance source from 1 April.
transcript:
Meeting: Finance x Support sync
Date: 2027-03-29
Time: 10:00 AM PT (recorded)
Duration: 34 min
Attendees (Redwood): Rishi Malhotra, Emily Stone, Cole Summers, Dev Patel, Owen Phillips

[00:00] Rishi Malhotra: Okay, let's start, main thing today is the ledger cut-over on Thursday.
[00:41] Cole Summers: Ledger's reconciled against all March invoices, to the penny. Every grant, application, expiry and reinstatement is an entry.
[01:30] Dev Patel: So what do my folks quote when a customer asks for their balance? Today they read credit_grants.
[01:52] Rishi Malhotra: From April first, only the ledger. Balances and expiry dates, both. That's the decision.
[02:10] Owen Phillips: And credit_grants?
[02:14] Cole Summers: Frozen as of March thirty-first. We stop updating it, so remaining amounts go stale and anything granted after that won't be in it at all.
[02:31] Rishi Malhotra: Right, so nobody quotes from credit_grants after the cut-over. Not even as a cross-check with the customer.
[02:45] Dev Patel: Got it. I'll tell the queue before Thursday.
[03:02] Emily Stone: I'll put a reading guide on the Finance space, entry types and expiry.
[05:20] Rishi Malhotra: Second item, March close timing...
